scope: Read-only observations of already admitted lifecycle/state frames; no engine command, query RPC, reflection or extrapolation.

findings.result: The same admitted protocol 1/2/3 frames produce stable instance views and typed UUID queries. Definition queries preserve all repeated instances; engine-local numeric handles and process-supplied file paths are never query identities.

The generic host derives the view only after reconstructing and verifying the frozen plan/artifact/tool. The session persists the last valid sample across cancellation/failure. A separate view survives the bounded raw event ring.

The UI renders detached host data and filters locally, labels startup/end/stale samples, and delegates source navigation using the frozen source revision. It cannot supply executable, backend, output path or Entity handles through inspect.

Existing ready/state/finished data was sufficient for this inspection layer. It did not justify changing author scene/build formats, execution adapter contracts or engine protocols. Active control, reflection and fresh position sampling remain separate future capabilities.
